current_flow: governed-joins builds ONE closed, typed, code-composed governed financial relation: DUB actuals are reduced to (gl_code, month) and full-outer-joined (zero-filled) to an active (gl_code, month) budget rollup that preserves the Budget-Components label set; code-authored Actual/Budget/% measures sit over it with the nil rule (0/0 NA, positive over-budget, negative credit); a governed-financial read action + in-CTE two-sided scope enforce access at the SelectionExecutor boundary; provenance carries per-(source,period) batch ids + row-aligned source-presence captured in-query; and golden-answer fixtures (matched/one-sided/duplicate-no-fan-out/reload/%-edges) gate it as demonstrated host evidence (D-0008). Decomposition: gl-month-rollups -> composed-relation -> governed-domain-measures -> golden-provenance.
new_abstractions: a closed, typed code-composed governed financial relation (Budget⋈Actual on gl_code+month, both sides reduced + scoped, zero-filled)
GL+month active rollups for both sides (DUB actual reduction + active budget rollup preserving the label set)
a governed-financial read action + in-CTE two-sided scope at the SelectionExecutor boundary
provenance keyed by (source, period) with row-aligned source-presence + Budget-Components label sets
gaps: The no-fan-out claim was false: actual_by_key_month is Plant+CostCenter+GL+month, not GL+month, so joining it directly to a GL+month budget rollup repeats Budget for every Actual cost centre (double-counts Budget).

The composed-relation contract was undefined: the model assumes goldObject is ONE physical relation used not only by SQL construction but by validator allow-lists, freshness, dimension enumeration, RBAC scope validation, Help, and reconciliation; 'extend the builder (or add a provider)' left all those consumers undefined and left a persisted joined view as an unresolved exception to 0016's code-composed requirement.

Governed-read enforcement + two-sided scope was not real: allowedFor only FILTERS metadata, RequireAction is only a controller guard, no governed-read action exists, and the builder injects a single outer predicate while Budget has no persisted plant - so 0016's 'predicate inside both join inputs' could not be met.

The provenance snapshot shape was wrong: active batches are unique per (source_kind, period), not globally, so 'two active batch ids' is incorrect for multi-month/YTD answers; fetching after execution can race a reload; current provenance is response-wide with no typed per-row metadata; and a single Budget Component is undefined when several labels share a GL.
Zero-Budget NEGATIVE actuals had no behaviour: the settled nil rule covers 0/0 and Actual>0,Budget=0, but Actual = Debit-Credit can be negative and the plan defined nothing for Actual<0, Budget=0.
Roll-over was contradictory: decision 0016 defers the Roll-over MEASURE, yet the plan carried roll-over 'through measures'.
The proposed Budget rollup dropped the 'Budget Components' source field, which 0016 requires kept as informational.

The D-0008 proof was not falsifiable: no single owning task, exact committed file, registered command/leaf, TS_NODE_PROJECT, WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1, or loopback/dead-port control, and no exact test-list / quality-gate registry update.

The plan would not save: missing decisions_reviewed frontmatter for all active decisions, the required classified Surface Impact rows, and per-task user_facing flags; and it named a nonexistent path backend/src/semantic/selectionExecutor.ts (it lives under backend/src/chat/).
resolutions: The composed relation first reduces DUB actuals to (gl_code, month) - SUM(actual_net) over cost centres, WHERE plant='DUB' - and joins that to an active (gl_code, month) budget rollup; both sides are one row per key, so there is no fan-out. A duplicate/multi-cost-centre golden case proves Budget is not repeated.

Defined ONE closed, typed, code-composed financial relation registry (no persisted joined view, no task-level choice) whose goldObject resolves to the two source CTEs full-outer-joined on (gl_code, month) with COALESCE zero-fill; it lists EVERY physical object in objectsTouched and provides equivalent relation semantics to the SQL builder, sqlValidator allow-list, freshness, dimension enumeration, RBAC scope validation, Help and reconciliation - replacing sqlBuilder's scaffold rejection with a governed composed path (the LLM only selects).

Add one governed-financial READ action to GRANT_ACTIONS, require it + the domain + Actual/Budget/% grants at the shared SelectionExecutor execution boundary (backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts), and inject the scope predicate INSIDE each source CTE before the join (Actual by plant, Budget by its trusted derived constant DUB); add a denial case and a predicate-placement test.

Provenance returns typed metadata captured by the SAME composed query: active source batch ids keyed by (source, period) (correct for multi-month), row-aligned source-presence (matched / budget-only / actual-only, or a source-presence SET for aggregate rows), and a deterministic SET of informational Budget-Components labels; no post-execution reload race.

HUMAN-decided (round): for every non-zero Actual with zero Budget, return NO percentage; label a positive Actual 'over-budget' and a negative Actual 'credit / negative actual'; add both as exact golden-fixture cases.

Defer the Roll-over MEASURE explicitly (pending Srihari's rule) and label it Deferred in Surface Impact; keep the raw rollover_amount column carried through the rollup untouched, exposed by no measure.
The active-budget rollup PRESERVES the cost_center (Budget Components) label as an informational SET per (gl_code, month) key, never a join key.

One owning task (golden-provenance) commits the gated proof at an exact backend file via a dedicated WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 flag-setting runnable script (with TS_NODE_PROJECT + WAREHOUSE_PG_*), loopback-host guarded with a dead-port negative control, added to the exact test list + quality-gate registry (per 0009 + the sap-ingestion D-0008 lessons).
Added decisions_reviewed frontmatter (0001-0016), classified Surface Impact rows, and per-task user_facing:false flags; corrected the executor path to backend/src/chat/selectionExecutor.ts.
open_items: Roll-over measure deferred (raw rollover_amount preserved) pending Srihari's roll-over rule.
Mapping master / balanced allocation, per-plant row-scoping, and asymmetric-RBAC policy deferred (0016).

rounds.question: governed-joins plan grill (Q4): the settled %-nil rule covers 0/0 (NA/blank) and Actual>0,Budget=0 (over-budget). But Actual = Debit − Credit can be NEGATIVE (a net credit), and the spec defines no behavior for Actual<0 with Budget=0. What should the governed layer show for a NEGATIVE actual against zero budget?

summary: One cold read returned nine blocking plan gaps. Eight are repository/decision/spec-answerable and resolved in the amended plan: the fan-out fix (reduce DUB actuals to gl_code+month before the join); a single closed typed code-composed financial relation registry serving every gold-object consumer; a governed-financial read action with the scope predicate injected inside both source CTEs; provenance keyed by (source,period) with row-aligned source-presence + label sets captured in-query; explicit Roll-over-measure deferral with the raw column kept; preserved Budget-Components labels; a falsifiable one-task D-0008 proof (flag-setting runnable script + loopback/dead-port control + registry updates); and the save-blocking structure (decisions_reviewed, classified Surface Impact, per-task user_facing, corrected executor path). One was a genuine spec-uncovered display decision put to the human: a negative Actual against zero Budget shows no percentage and is labelled 'credit / negative actual'. Verdict pass.
